entry_authority.scientific_revision: Materially revised fixed-eight-root conditional mechanism screen, not an F64 correction or rerun.

claim_scope.question: For exactly eight frozen learner-reached public roots and their frozen source-actor holes, does a bounded exact-V5.5 depth-two MCCFR+ root policy improve conditional paired value over H11 under one common frozen post-root H11-P256 continuation law?
claim_scope.pass_next: A PASS authorizes a separately preregistered broader F64R2 teacher-feasibility design; it does not authorize teacher assets,BC,RL or quick5k.
claim_scope.no_quick5k_reason: F8R1 creates no deployable checkpoint and changes no official greedy-direct policy.

falsifiable_hypothesis.mechanism: A full-joint blocker-aware posterior and source-hole-oversampled depth-two MCCFR+ update can improve the frozen source actor's root distribution on eight fixed learner-reached decisions.
falsifiable_hypothesis.primary_estimand: theta=(1/8)*sum_r E[d_r | root_r,source_actor_hole_r], where d_r is candidate-root minus canonical-H11-root payoff and both arms use the same H11-P256 continuation law.
falsifiable_hypothesis.E1_primary_gate: One-sided conditional 95% LCB(theta)>=+0.20 big blinds per reached root.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation: The threshold is an engineering mechanism gate for these eight roots only and has no bb/100 conversion.

counter_rng.bounded_integer: For n,limit=2^64-(2^64 mod n);reject uint64>=limit with incremented counter;return uint64 mod n.
counter_rng.deck: Fisher-Yates from i=51 down to1 using domain CENSUS_DECK,hand_index,i and unbiased bounded_integer(i+1).
counter_rng.disjointness: Exact domain strings are disjoint and every raw seed/key is retained in immutable manifests.

probability_routine.name: LEGAL_LOGITS_CPU_F64_CDF_V1
probability_routine.input: Take the exact float32 logit row from the frozen network and copy it to CPU without softmax.
probability_routine.legal_math: Cast legal logits to numpy.float64; subtract legal maximum; numpy.exp; divide by numpy.float64 sum; write into slot0..8 with illegal exactly0.
probability_routine.cdf: numpy.cumsum in slot order over the nine float64 probabilities; require finite,nonnegative,sum error<=2e-15;set only the final legal slot CDF to exactly1.0.
probability_routine.sample: Take the smallest legal slot whose CDF is strictly greater than uniform_open01.
probability_routine.log_likelihood: numpy.log of the same stored float64 observed-slot probability.
probability_routine.shared_authority: Canonical root generation,history likelihood,baseline root action and H11-P256 leaves all call this one routine.
forbidden: alternate scalar,batch or reordered probability routine

canonical_root_and_belief_policy.combo_order: Unordered own hole=(min_card,max_card),lexicographic over card integers after excluding the current public board only.
canonical_root_and_belief_policy.chunks: Contiguous canonical chunks; row=global_index mod256; final real row duplicated through row255 in the last chunk and padding discarded.
canonical_root_and_belief_policy.census_actual_hole: At a census decision run only the exact canonical chunk containing the actual actor hole and use its canonical row.
canonical_root_and_belief_policy.history_likelihood: For each selected-root public prefix run every canonical chunk and retain observed-slot log probability for every candidate actor hole.
canonical_root_and_belief_policy.coherence: The census actual-hole row is bit-identical to the same row in the full canonical pass.
canonical_root_and_belief_policy.repeat: Identical call bytes must produce bit-identical logits,probabilities,CDF and sampled slot for a fixed uniform.

root_census.game: Fresh independently implemented exact-cent 200bb HUNL public engine; both players frozen canonical H11 stochastic; exact nonnull V5.5 nine-slot actions only.
root_census.hand_to_cell: CENSUS_CELL bounded_integer(8) fixes exactly one target cell before the hand.
root_census.within_hand: Among eligible decisions in that preassigned cell retain the smallest CENSUS_SELECT digest.
root_census.between_hands: After all16384 complete hands choose the smallest retained digest in each cell.
eligibility: at least two legal nonnull V5.5 slots
complete public history reconstructable without amount projection
no seventh same-street action has occurred
selection digest contains only identity,cell,hand index and canonical public serialization
hidden cards,outcome,reward,policy probability and solver output are excluded
root_census.failure: Decision cap,missing cell quota,invalid chosen root or duplicate source hand is terminal F8R1 NONPASS;never replace a root.

belief.joint_target: mu_r(h0,h1) proportional to the uniform ordered disjoint-hole prior times every chronological canonical-H11 observed-action probability under the acting player's candidate own hole.
belief.domain: Both unordered holes exclude current board and each other; preserve full joint,never multiply marginals.
belief.source_hole: The selected source actor hole is frozen only after public root selection and must have positive marginal. It never enters public selection or alternative-hole likelihoods.

game_tree.solver_actions: Exact executable nonnull V5.5 slots on the fresh exact-cent engine.
game_tree.depth_count: Player decisions beginning at root; chance does not consume depth.
game_tree.nonterminal_leaf: Continue both players under H11-LEAF-P256 to terminal.
game_tree.same_street_observation: If a seventh action on one street would be required anywhere, terminal F8R1 NONPASS;no truncation,projection or recursive fallback.

leaf_policy_P256.name: H11_LEAF_P256_PERMANENT_512_LANES_LATIN_V1
leaf_policy_P256.distinction: This is a separately defined numerical leaf policy,not claimed bit-equivalent to canonical root/belief H11.
leaf_policy_P256.network_mode: eval,no_grad,no_autocast,no_compile,batch shape exactly256 for each of two physical chunks.

solver_cohort.branch_lanes: Each group owns9 logical action-rank lanes;288 active-capable logical lanes inside a permanent512-lane universe.
solver_cohort.physical_lane: (logical_lane + 73*outer_iteration) mod512;gcd(73,512)=1,so every logical lane visits every physical position exactly16 times across8192 iterations.
solver_cohort.chunks: physical0..255 then256..511;always execute both batch256 chunks at every continuation step.
solver_cohort.inactive: All unassigned,illegal,terminal or earlier-finished lanes retain position and use one canonical public dummy observation;never compact.
solver_cohort.identity_independence: Lane mapping excludes hidden cards,action amount,profile label,outcome and network output. Action rank is exactly balanced across every position by the Latin translation.

evaluation_cohort.lanes: Tapes are grouped in fixed waves of512 by preregistered tape index;two batch256 chunks per continuation step.
evaluation_cohort.pairing: Baseline,replica and ensemble profiles execute separate passes but the same tape always has the same lane. Profile is excluded from lane and uniform keys.
evaluation_cohort.inactive: Terminal and unused final-wave lanes become canonical dummy and never compact.

leaf_policy_P256.randomness: Leaf policy and chance uniforms use phase/tape/public-node/visit keys that exclude profile;identical state,tape,lane receives identical CDF,uniform and action.
metamorphic_gates: Changing all other255 batch rows while target state and row remain fixed leaves target logits bit-identical.
Inserting,deleting or terminating other logical trajectories does not change target permanent lane,logits,CDF,uniform or action.
Baseline and candidate with identical own state have identical lane,logits,CDF,uniform and action.
Each legal solver action rank occupies every physical position exactly16 times per root-replica-traverser.

solver.snapshots: single endpoint T=8192 only;no checkpoint selection,extension,restart or top-up

proposal.source_event: A={root actor own hole equals frozen source hole}
proposal.sampling: Sample from the full mixture density q;never use latent mixture-component-specific weights.

solver.iteration: For each root and replica freeze sigma_t;run independent traverser0 and traverser1 samples from q;future chance and nontraverser actions sample their target laws;traverser enumerates all legal slots;collect both delta tables;apply simultaneously.

regret.raw_action_return: y_a from the traverser's utility sign
regret.next_sigma: Normalize positive legal regrets;uniform over legal slots if sum0;illegal mass/regret exactly0.

source_root_average.stream: Before applying each iteration update,use only the root actor's current sigma_t(I_star);the opponent traversal sample never updates this average.

contract_tests: Independent exhaustive one-iteration hidden-chance toy-game oracle including q weights and simultaneous clipping.
Changing q away from target without registered mu/q weight must fail.
One root-average stream matches direct sum_t t*sigma_t reference bit-exactly.
Fixed-seed Kuhn or Leduc sanity convergence is descriptive only.

E0.conditional_deal: Fix source actor hole;sample only opponent hole from mu(h_opp|source hole),then future cards without replacement.
E0.continuation: Every profile uses H11-LEAF-P256 after exactly one root action.
E0.pairing: Same opponent hole,chance,root uniform,permanent lane and keyed post-root uniforms across profiles.
E0.estimand: Equal-weight mean over the eight fixed roots;roots are not resampled.
E0.bootstrap: 100000 deterministic paired replicates;within each fixed root resample4096 tapes with replacement,then average eight root means;one-sided lower 5th percentile is ordered replicate5001 without interpolation.
E0.failure: Terminal F8R1 scientific NONPASS;E1 remains sealed.

E1.sealed_before_E0: Seed-manifest bytes and SHA exist before E0 and are not available to the E0/solver process.
E1.open_condition: Fresh process requires immutable candidate manifest binding both replica policies,ensemble,E0 raw hashes and unopened E1 manifest SHA.
E1.conditional_deal_pairing_and_continuatio: Exactly the E0 estimand with disjoint E1 keys and H11-LEAF-P256.
E1.bootstrap: 100000 deterministic paired within-root resamples;fixed roots never resampled;ordered replicate5001 is one-sided95% LCB.
E1.primary_gate: theta_LCB>=0.20 big blinds per reached root.
E1.failure: Terminal F8R1 scientific NONPASS;never return to E0,change candidate,top up or reuse E1.

confidence_limit.experimental_units: Independent paired E0/E1 tapes conditional on each of eight fixed roots/source holes.
confidence_limit.fixed_roots: There is one root per cell,so no root-population variance is estimated. Root resampling and learner-population generalization are forbidden.
confidence_limit.solver_randomness: Frozen candidate conditional;not included in E1 confidence interval.
confidence_limit.multiplicity: One preregistered E1 primary quantity;no multiplicity adjustment needed.

solver_leaf_P256.formula: 8192 iterations*32 continuation steps*2 physical batch256 chunks

resource_admission.position: After fresh implementation and an instantiated independent implementation audit PASS;before any census hand,root,belief,solver row or evaluation tape.
synthetic_exact_kernels: canonical actual-hole batch256 call plus LEGAL_LOGITS_CPU_F64_CDF_V1
two-chunk permanent512-lane P256 call with canonical dummies and CPU-f64 CDF
fresh exact-cent vector transition and leaf-step scheduling
joint logsumexp,mixture q sampling and mu/q weights
raw outcome serialization,hashing and bootstrap kernel
resource_admission.blocks: Exactly8 post-warmup fixed blocks per kernel;use minimum observed block rate.
resource_admission.projection: Independently multiply every exact work-table count by its measured minimum-rate reciprocal,add measured fixed load/finalization,then multiply variable total by1.25.

implementation_and_audit.fresh_runtime_graph: fresh exact-cent engine->strict H11 loader/encoder->canonical root census/belief->importance external-sampling MCCFR+->P256 leaves->E0->candidate freeze->sealed E1->exclusive evidence
implementation_and_audit.preimplementation_audit: Must independently instantiate probability,CDF,RNG,root selection,mu/q,regret,root average,lane mapping,profile pairing,confidence and exact work formulas;keyword predicates are insufficient.
implementation_and_audit.implementation_audit: Must execute independent no-model contract oracles for exact-cent rules,RNG,probability routine with supplied logits,tiny MCCFR+,permanent-lane metamorphics,E0/E1 separation and exact counts before resource admission.
implementation_and_audit.result_audit: Independently rehash and recompute every raw count,root/range/proposal/update/lane/profile/bootstrap/resource gate before judgment.
implementation_and_audit.exclusive_outputs: Create-new only;no overwrite,mutable latest pointer,reconstruction from missing raw evidence or mutation of frozen attempts.

abort_on: seventh same-street action,nonfinite value or missing raw evidence
abort_and_judgment.rollback: All F8R1 outputs are research-only;H11 remains the only official policy.
abort_and_judgment.route_effect: PASS advances to broader F64R2 design. NONPASS triggers same-turn scientific reranking but alone does not exhaust the exact-V5.5 teacher family.
